fieldData.job-spec:
What is the role?

Despite decentralized finance (DeFi) growing from a $1Bn to a $250Bn+ industry in just a few years, developers are still spending most of their time battling code. In November 2021, a groundbreaking new programming language for DeFi, Scrypto, was previewed to the world by RDX Works. Over 6,000 people tuned in to watch the live demonstrations.

Scrypto is built around an entirely new asset-oriented paradigm of development that finally gives DeFi developers what they need: making build, test, and iteration cycles short; massively reducing the complexity of safe management of digital assets; and helping get new developers from DeFi curious to DeFi competent quickly and effectively. Scrypto deeply leverages Rust, but adds new capabilities specifically for finance in a public decentralized network environment.

In the lead-up to the Radix Babylon release, where smart contracts can be deployed on the Radix Public Network, we will be promoting Scrypto to a wide range of developers and we’re are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to help guide the messaging, targeting, and go-to-market of Scrypto to maximize adoption and retention.

Your role will be to strategize and execute a well-funded and global multi-year plan to turn the Radix DeFi dev community from the small passionate tribe it is today, into something world-beating. Scrypto is your secret weapon, the Radix community is your platform, rebuilding the global financial system is the target market for the community you empower.

If you have proven experience taking a developer-focused product to market, ideally within blockchain/crypto markets, and are skilled in listening to and engaging a developer community, we would love to hear from you.

Listen to our CEO and CPO talking about Scrypto, DeFi, and the importance of developer community: https://youtu.be/Hn20w1gmpMw?t=340

What we’re looking for

  • You understand how to market to developer audiences, including enthusiasts, open-source developers, and professional developers considering new opportunities to pursue in their free time.
  • You will be an expert on the developer demographics we are targeting, their pain points, and who is able to effectively message the benefits of building with Scrypto.
  • You are confident in translating technical details of a new and unique programming language experience into clear benefits to the developer, and how it will help them succeed in a competitive marketplace.
  • Someone who enjoys research and is able to understand the needs of crypto/blockchain developers, competitor development languages and tools, and engage internally with the various teams working on Scrypto and wider RDX marketing.
  • A person who understands that to effectively engage a developer community, you need to be a true evangelist for the product and DeFi industry.
  • Someone who is able to engage with existing customers and those in the user journey at all stages from awareness to brand advocate, to better understand how to improve conversion at all stages of the funnel.
  • Someone with creative flair who is able to produce compelling messaging to a wide range of potential users.

What do you need?

  • 5+ years experience in product marketing roles, with at least 2+ years of experience with products that developers use to build - not just APIs they integrate to
  • Experience and knowledge of crypto/blockchain is a plus
  • Familiarity and confidence in producing and executing product marketing strategies
  • Comfortable engaging directly with existing users of both our own products and competitor products to gain an understanding of our users
  • Excellent written and verbal English skills

Who are we?

At RDX Works (formally Radix DLT), we're a team of like-minded thinkers who have long been convinced that we're living in the earliest stages of a global financial revolution. This revolution is being fuelled by decentralized finance (or DeFi for short), which is enabling an assortment of pioneering developers and entrepreneurs to re-invent almost every financial product that is currently traded and invested in traditional markets, without requiring central authorities or siloed infrastructure. DeFi has captured a great deal of attention and investment in the crypto-aware niche, growing assets under management from $1 billion to $40 billion in less than a year. Impressive as its growth has been, its current market size isn't even a rounding error on the over $111 trillion held in traditional finance. We're focused on what it will take to go from billions to trillions.

RDX went back to first principles to come up with the right technical solution—the first layer-one protocol built specifically for mainstream DeFi—and we have already tested out at over 1 million transactions per second. We're keenly aware that the need for an infinitely scalable platform is only one prerequisite among many for mass adoption, and we're also blazing new ground in the areas of purpose-built developer tools, user experiences, and regulatory integration.

We have forged a path deep into the future of what distributed ledger technology is going to look like and we need you to come and be part of the team that is making that happen right now.

If this job sounds like it was made for you, then please apply here or email farrah@rdx.works for more information.
